item.title: Your agent's permissions are tighter than your policy thinks
item.author: obengbuo@aegisruntime.dev (Obeng Buo)
item.description: Literal argument matching eliminates path traversal for single values. It says nothing about lists. Two capability-scoping bypasses in an MCP enforcement layer, how batched tool calls silently remove argument scoping, and the fix.
